title: UK Politician Jess Asato Sues xAI Over Deepfake
excerpt: UK Member of Parliament Jess Asato is taking xAI to court after becoming a target of the Grok deepfake scandal.
body_html:
UK Member of Parliament Jess Asato is taking legal action against xAI following a deepfake incident involving the company's Grok tool.

Asato had previously campaigned publicly on behalf of victims of online abuse. Shortly after, she became a target herself when a deepfake image was generated.

The legal move highlights ongoing concerns surrounding AI-generated synthetic media and the accountability of platform developers regarding online abuse and harassment.
